name: William Shakespeare
original_name: ウィリアム・シェイクスピア
source:
Shakespeare is regarded as the world's greatest dramatist with a good reason; he is extremely skilled at the observation and analysis of the human heart. He is a gentleman who never fails to treat you with the utmost respect.
However, there's a reason he lives separately from everyong else, and it is rooted in his duplicitous nature...


"O, what upturned expectations have come at the arrival of this new player?"
